# 3 bed detached house for sale

> A rare and distinctive detached family home occupying an exceptionally private site in a highly sought-after Douglas location. 1A Lime Trees Road is an impressive three-bedroom detached family home extending to approximately 1,700 sq. ft., set on approximately ¼ acre of private grounds.

- Druh nabídky: sale

- Plocha: 147 m²
- Energetická náročnost: D1
- Lokalita: 1A Lime Trees Road, Lower Maryborough Hill, Douglas
